_meta._note: Agent menu Task B (plan task 10): register 14 new agentic benchmarks (no scores). Scores ingested separately in Task D (plan tasks 18-23). All URLs verified 200 OK on 2026-05-08.

benchmarks.name: Aider Polyglot (6-language code gen)
benchmarks._note: 133 problems across Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/Go/Rust/+1. Tests raw model code generation in isolation (not agent framework).

benchmarks.name: SWE-Lancer (1400 freelance SWE tasks)
benchmarks._note: OpenAI 2025 — real-world software contracting tasks across 1488 freelance jobs from Upwork. Pricing-aware grading.

benchmarks.name: MLE-Bench (75 Kaggle ML competitions)
benchmarks._note: OpenAI 2024 — measures ML engineering ability via Kaggle competitions. Bronze/silver/gold medal scoring.

benchmarks.name: USACO Competitive Programming
benchmarks._note: Princeton HAL re-hosted USACO competitive programming benchmark.

benchmarks.name: AppWorld (750 interactive coding tasks)
benchmarks._note: ACL 2024 best resource paper. 750 tasks across 9 simulated apps with 457 APIs. Function-calling + interactive code execution.

benchmarks.name: HAL Composite (cost-controlled accuracy)
benchmarks._note: Princeton HAL aggregate metric. Cost-bounded accuracy across SWE-bench, GAIA, TAU-bench, AppWorld, USACO. ICLR 2026.

benchmarks.name: MobileAgentBench (100 tasks, 10 OSS apps)
benchmarks._note: OpenReview 2024. 100 tasks across 10 open-source Android apps. Reduced manual testing burden via automated checkers.

benchmarks.name: Mobile-Bench-v2 (VLM mobile agent)
benchmarks._note: Slot-based instruction generation. Multi-path evaluation. Tests VLM-based mobile UI agents.

benchmarks.name: Mobile-Bench (Xiaomi, 103 APIs)
benchmarks._note: Xiaomi-released LLM-based mobile agent benchmark. 103 APIs across UI operations to accelerate task completion.

benchmarks.name: MLPerf Mobile LLM Inference
benchmarks._note: MLCommons. Android/iOS LoadGen single-stream and offline inference latency for LLMs on mobile platforms.

benchmarks.name: MLPerf Inference: Edge v5.1
benchmarks._note: MLCommons v5.1. Edge accelerator latency benchmark with 99/99.9% reference-model accuracy bound.

benchmarks.name: MLPerf Tiny v1.2 (<100kB MCU models)
benchmarks._note: MLCommons v1.2. Microcontroller models <100kB on MCUs/DSPs operating 10-250 MHz, <50 mW power draw.

benchmarks.name: TinyML Energy & Latency v1
benchmarks._note: Joint energy and latency metric for resource-constrained AI. Novel evaluation method beyond pure accuracy.

benchmarks.name: FunctionGemma Calling (LiteRT-LM Tool Use)
benchmarks._note: Google AI Edge. On-device function-calling benchmark via LiteRT-LM Tool Use APIs. FunctionGemma evaluation.
